newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK FEB INFLATION SEEN BELOW 6.8PCT, 6.5PCT UNLIKELY.
newsitem.headline: GREEK FEB INFLATION SEEN BELOW 6.8PCT, 6.5PCT UNLIKELY.

text.p: Greece's February consumer price inflation will drop below January's 6.8 percent year-on-year figure but the market consensus of 6.5 percent is unlikely, a government source said.

"All indications point to a February inflation figure below 6.8 percent year-on-year," said the source. "But the 6.5 percent figure is unlikely." He expected CPI-based inflation to come out in the 6.6-6.7 percent range.
An informal Reuters poll of fifteen Greek bankers and economists on Tuesday produced a mean inflation forecast of 6.5 percent for February. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
